summary: Backend-only verification of the new DELETE /api/auth/me account deletion endpoint on EscalaFácil. Wrote a dedicated pytest suite (test_account_deletion.py) with 13 tests covering: user registration + full data seed (workplace, shift override, holiday, extra event); DELETE /api/auth/me returning 204; token invalidation (GET /api/auth/me and /api/workplaces returning 401 after delete); login with the original credentials returning 401 because password_hash was cleared; re-registration with the same email succeeding (201) and no stale data visible for the new account; DELETE /api/auth/me with no token / bogus token returning 401. All 13 tests pass against the public preview URL. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_me endpoint (server.py:265-285) correctly anonymises the user (email → deleted-<uid>@deleted.local, password_hash cleared, deleted_at timestamp) and deletes owned workplaces/shift_overrides/holidays/extra_events. Verified end-to-end.
get_current_user (server.py:220-221) properly rejects tokens whose user document has deleted_at set – confirmed by 401 responses on /auth/me and /workplaces after deletion.
Email is normalised to lowercase by backend (via Pydantic EmailStr / storage). Not a bug, but tests must submit lowercase emails to match on read-back. Documented in the test file.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers a unique user (test_delme_<uuid>@example.com), creates 1 workplace + 1 shift override + 1 holiday + 1 extra event, then deletes the account – all seeded data is anonymised/purged by the endpoint under test. A second re-registered account with the same email is also deleted at the end of the flow, leaving no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest config in /app/backend/pytest.ini has default addopts using pytest-xdist (-n auto --dist loadscope). Module-scoped fixtures survive because loadscope keeps a class together on one worker, but if you ever split, pass `-o addopts=` to force serial. Backend base URL: https://nurse-scheduler-15.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Auth is Bearer JWT via /api/auth/register|login. Emails are stored lowercase.
rca_of_issue: N/A – the endpoint works as specified. Initial test failures during authoring were due to the test asserting mixed-case emails against a lowercase-normalised backend response; fixed by using lowercase test emails.
